issue: Two VOMITING records with identical dates (start and end 2013-02-12) have conflicting outcomes, and one shows an end date with outcome Not Recovered.
query_text: There are two Adverse Event records for VOMITING, both with start date 2013-02-12 and end date 2013-02-12, mild severity and not related. One record (AE seq 1) has outcome "NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED" even though it has an end date. The other (AE seq 2) has outcome "RECOVERED/RESOLVED". Were these two separate episodes, or is one a duplicate entry? If they are separate, please confirm the dates and outcome of each. If one is a duplicate, please remove it and confirm the correct outcome.

issue: Two MICTURITION URGENCY records with identical dates (2013-02-15 to 2013-03-19) have conflicting outcomes, and one shows an end date with outcome Not Recovered.
query_text: There are two Adverse Event records for MICTURITION URGENCY, both starting 2013-02-15 and ending 2013-03-19, mild severity, relationship "possible". AE seq 3 has outcome "NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED" despite having an end date. AE seq 6 has outcome "RECOVERED/RESOLVED". Is one of these a duplicate entry? issue: HEADACHE is recorded as an adverse event with start year 2002, before study entry, and is also recorded in medical history as a pre-existing condition.
query_text: HEADACHE is recorded on the Adverse Events form with start date "2002", moderate severity, ongoing. Headache is also recorded in Medical History as a significant pre-existing condition. First dose was 2013-02-12. Did this pre-existing condition worsen in frequency or severity after the first dose? If so, please enter the start date of the worsening and update the verbatim term to describe it. If not, please consider whether this record belongs only in Medical History.

issue: Disposition shows discontinuation due to an adverse event, but no AE has action taken recorded, and the only candidate events (application site reactions) start 2013-03-19, the day after the last dose on 2013-03-18.
query_text: The Disposition form records discontinuation due to "ADVERSE EVENT" on 2013-03-23 (Week 6). Last dose of study drug is recorded as 2013-03-18. However, "action taken with study drug" is blank for all adverse events. The application site erythema, pruritus and vesicles (moderate, possibly related, ongoing) all have a start date of 2013-03-19, which is the day after the last dose. Please confirm which adverse event(s) led to discontinuation and update "action taken" accordingly. Please also confirm the start dates of the application site events and the last dose date. If the reactions led to stopping study drug, they would be expected to start on or before the last dose.
